name: research-wiki
description: Pre-review surface for LLM-Wiki: read the formal revision, read the same-time reviewable candidate set, append prereview reports and invalidation decisions, and create one merged candidate.
notes: No formalize_wiki, no decide_wiki_review, no preview_wiki_review, no create_wiki_merge_request. Adjudication belongs to the Project Owner.
The Wiki side spells the review decision decide_wiki_review and gates it on the formalize capability; it is absent here for the same reason formalize_candidate is absent on the Mapping side.

append_prereview_log and create_merged_candidate are the same two tools as the Mapping card, with the same append-only and no-re-merge rules; only the domain identifier and the payload shape differ (document_change instead of change_set).

tools.name: get_formal_wiki
tools.description: Read the current formal Wiki revision for a domain. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: list_wiki_candidates
tools.description: Read candidate submissions for a Wiki domain. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: list_reviewable_wiki_candidates
tools.description: Read the same-time reviewable Wiki candidate set (not merged, rejected or abandoned) with exact candidate head, base formal revision and immutable content snapshot. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: append_prereview_log
tools.description: Append one Wiki prereview report, or one invalidation decision, to the Wiki governance log. Append-only: reports and decisions are never edited. Passing ``reason`` (head_moved/base_moved) appends an invalidation decision; otherwise a report row is appended under the (candidate_id, candidate_head, rule_set_version, base_formal_revision_id) unique key. Requires the prereview_log capability.

tools.name: create_merged_candidate
tools.description: Create one merged Wiki candidate branch from source candidates on the same formal base. Only creates a new branch; existing candidates are never edited. The author field records every source author; source authors get no operation rights; a merged candidate may not be merged again. Requires the merged_candidate capability.
